fieldNotes.location: ROSTER ADDRESS WRONG. Roster gave '5555 Sterilite St SE, Canton OH 44730' which geocoded 17.1 km off into a generic warehouse/distribution area in eastern Canton. Web research identifies the real plant as '4030 16th St SW, Canton OH 44710' (Frito-Lay North America / Rold Gold Foods Division — pretzels; production began 1967, ~150 employees). Positively confirmed in 2019 Street View: the Frito-Lay red sun logo on the building and an orange/yellow Frito-Lay 'Canton Plant' monument sign. Locked center at 40.78310, -81.42220.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled barrier gate or checkpoint resolved at the plant entrance — the office/parking and building front are open directly to the access road in Street View. Classified false; flagged as the drop-yard perimeter has some fencing but no clear truck-gate barrier was visible.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any entrance. False.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the NW building face (trailers backed in) and a covered loading area on the south face; aggregate estimated ~25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard west of the plant with ~2 rows of trailers (~40-50) plus dock-staged trailers; 25-50 band. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock clusters on physically separate building faces (NW and south).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south perimeter; no active spur clearly entering the plant was resolved (older plants of this era sometimes had sidings). Marked false; flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the city of Canton, OH in a dense urban industrial district. Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Ample internal paved approach depth between the access road and the dock faces — can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing building plus an attached warehouse and a separate metal warehouse/garage in the west yard; ~3 buildings on one contiguous site.
